name: Grape Tasks
description: Your Grape issues in an Orca sidebar panel: read the requirement, then dispatch it into the focused workspace as an agent prompt.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Grape Tasks: issues waiting on you

settings.title: Grape base URL
settings.description: Grape server root, without a trailing slash. The API key itself is stored as a plugin secret, not here.

settings.title: Default agent
settings.description: Agent CLI started in the focused workspace when an issue is dispatched.

settings.title: Issue status filter
settings.description: Only list issues in this status. Empty lists every status Grape returns.

settings.title: Repository filter
settings.description: Optional repo_key such as owner/repo. Empty means every repository.

settings.title: Extra dispatch instructions
settings.description: Appended to every dispatched prompt, for example your team's branch and test conventions.

settings.title: Write results back to Grape
settings.description: When an agent this plugin started finishes, set the issue status and post one comment with the workspace and outcome. The final review stays with a person.

settings.title: Status after an agent finishes
settings.description: The issue status written back. Pending review puts it in the human review queue; empty leaves the status alone.

settings.title: Batch limit
settings.description: How many issues one batch dispatch may start. Each one gets its own worktree and agent.

settings.title: Self-hosted code host
settings.description: Host used for issue and repository links when the repository is not on gitcode.com or github.com, for example gitlab.internal.example.com. Empty means links for other hosts are hidden.
